# WAYKEEP

- Project: modular equipment lockers for shared mobility stations
- Setting: beneath station canopies
- System basis: existing D1 door family; S4 and L2 cabinet columns
- Dimension order: width × depth × height, except door leaves and station footprints

## Cabinet system

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Column pitch | 500 mm |
| Column depth | 600 mm |
| Column height | 1800 mm |
| S4 capacity | 4 small compartments |
| L2 capacity | 2 large compartments |
| Small minimum clear interior | 420 × 500 × 360 mm |
| Large minimum clear interior | 420 × 500 × 760 mm |
| Small D1 door leaf, width × height | 460 × 400 mm |
| Large D1 door leaf, width × height | 460 × 800 mm |
| Shared front control height | 1100 mm above floor |
| Public aisle, doors closed | 1200 mm |
| Rear maintenance aisle, panels closed | 900 mm |
| Maximum dismantled part envelope | 1800 × 600 × 100 mm |

## Materials and connections

| Part | Material or connection |
|---|---|
| Cabinet and doors | 1.5 mm galvanized steel; powder coating #243C46 |
| Removable trays | 2 mm 304 stainless steel |
| Adjacent column joint | 4 M8 bolts; 6 mm hex key |
| Each column base | 4 M10 floor anchors |
| Existing door hardware | Black recessed paddle; 2 exposed hinges per leaf |

## Station schedule

| Station | Footprint, width × depth | S4 columns | L2 columns | Small compartments | Large compartments |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Compact | 1500 × 2700 mm | 1 | 1 | 4 | 2 |
| Standard | 2500 × 2700 mm | 2 | 2 | 8 | 4 |
| Expanded | 3500 × 2700 mm | 3 | 3 | 12 | 6 |

## Fixed wording

| Location | Text |
|---|---|
| Station headers and presentation opening page | WAYKEEP |
| Station headers and presentation opening page | Store your gear. Continue your journey. |
| Free compartment state | Available |
| Stored equipment state | Occupied |
| Isolated compartment state | Service |

## Operating basis

- Public access: front
- Maintenance access: rear
- Storage access: size selection and card tap
- Retrieval access: same card
- State identification: text plus a distinct symbol for each state
- Equipment and component records: 03-equipment-and-sites.en.md

| 3 | assembly | Exploded assembly and parts schedule | 14 | Format: PNG, 2400 by 1600 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |
| 4 | small-compartment | S4 helmet compartment study | 14 | Format: PNG, 1800 by 1200 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |
| 5 | large-compartment | L2 backpack compartment study | 14 | Format: PNG, 1200 by 1800 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |
| 6 | compact-station | Compact station layout | 14 | Format: PNG, 2400 by 1600 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |
| 7 | standard-station | Standard station layout | 14 | Format: PNG, 2400 by 1600 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |
| 8 | expanded-station | Expanded station layout | 14 | Format: PNG, 2400 by 1600 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |
| 9 | storage-sequence | Public storage storyboard | 14 | Format: PNG, 1920 by 1080 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |
| 10 | retrieval-sequence | Public retrieval storyboard | 14 | Format: PNG, 1920 by 1080 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |
| 11 | maintenance-sequence | Rear maintenance storyboard | 14 | Format: PNG, 2400 by 1600 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |
| 12 | materials-status | Materials and status board | 14 | Format: PNG, 1800 by 1200 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |
| 13 | operation-video | Helmet storage and retrieval video | 14 | Format: video; 5 to 15 seconds. Stage: final. |
| 14 | presentation | Station system presentation | 14 | Format: presentation document; at least eight actual pages. Stage: final. |

# Equipment and station records

## Equipment envelopes

| Item | Width | Depth | Height | Assigned compartment | Stored orientation |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---|---|
| Helmet | 330 mm | 260 mm | 250 mm | Small | Upright |
| Backpack | 320 mm | 220 mm | 650 mm | Large | Upright |

## Station allocation

| Station | Footprint, width × depth | Column bank width | S4 | L2 | Small capacity | Large capacity | Front aisle | Rear aisle |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Compact | 1500 × 2700 mm | 1000 mm | 1 | 1 | 4 | 2 | 1200 mm | 900 mm |
| Standard | 2500 × 2700 mm | 2000 mm | 2 | 2 | 8 | 4 | 1200 mm | 900 mm |
| Expanded | 3500 × 2700 mm | 3000 mm | 3 | 3 | 12 | 6 | 1200 mm | 900 mm |

- Cabinet strip depth: 600 mm
- Side allowance: 250 mm at each end of the bank
- Aisle measurement state: doors and rear panels closed
- Ground: concrete slab
- Setting: canopy-covered station

## D1 door components

| Component | Record |
|---|---|
| Small leaf | 460 mm wide × 400 mm high; 20 mm folded depth |
| Large leaf | 460 mm wide × 800 mm high; 20 mm folded depth |
| Leaf material | 1.5 mm galvanized steel; powder coating #243C46 |
| Paddle | Black recessed vertical rectangle; 40 mm wide × 100 mm high |
| Paddle position | Centered vertically; centerline 60 mm from right edge |
| Hinges | 2 exposed stainless steel hinges on left edge |
| Hinge centers | 80 mm from top edge and 80 mm from bottom edge |
| Lock cassette | Rear-mounted, connected to station controller |
| Shared control center | 1100 mm above floor on public face |

## Storage sequence

| Step | User action | Compartment state |
|---:|---|---|
| 1 | Select an available compartment size at shared controls | Available |
| 2 | Tap card; assigned door unlocks | Available |
| 3 | Open door and place equipment inside | Available |
| 4 | Close door; lock engages | Occupied |

## Retrieval sequence

| Step | User action | Compartment state |
|---:|---|---|
| 1 | Tap the same card at shared controls | Occupied |
| 2 | Open assigned door and remove equipment | Occupied |
| 3 | Close door; lock engages | Available |

## Maintenance sequence

| Stage | Operator action | Compartment state | Access |
|---:|---|---|---|
| 1 | Select an empty compartment and isolate it | Service | Rear aisle |
| 2 | Open its rear service panel | Service | Rear aisle |
| 3 | Access lock cassette and wiring through the empty compartment | Service | Rear aisle |
| 4 | Refit components and close rear panel | Service | Rear aisle |
| 5 | Run controller cycle and return compartment to use | Available | Rear aisle |

## State records

| Label | Meaning |
|---|---|
| Available | Empty compartment ready for storage |
| Occupied | Compartment assigned to a user's card |
| Service | Compartment isolated for maintenance |

steps.userMessage:
WAYKEEP | Modular equipment lockers for shared mobility stations

We operate shared mobility stations and need a freestanding locker system for helmets and personal bags beneath our station canopies. The system uses two column types on a 500 mm pitch, each 600 mm deep and 1800 mm high: S4 contains four small compartments and L2 contains two large compartments. Minimum clear interiors, stated as width × depth × height, are 420 × 500 × 360 mm for small compartments and 420 × 500 × 760 mm for large compartments. Our helmet envelope is 330 × 260 × 250 mm; our backpack envelope is 320 × 220 × 650 mm. Develop the cabinet, compartment interiors and shared operating area around our existing D1 door family: 460 × 400 mm and 460 × 800 mm leaves with the same black recessed paddle and two exposed hinges.

Compact, Standard and Expanded stations have respective footprints of 1500 × 2700 mm, 2500 × 2700 mm and 3500 × 2700 mm. They take one, two and three columns of each type, respectively. Reserve a 1200 mm public aisle at the front and a 900 mm maintenance aisle at the rear, measured with doors and panels closed. Cabinets and doors use 1.5 mm galvanized steel with powder coating #243C46; removable trays use 2 mm 304 stainless steel. Each column joint uses four M8 bolts operated with a 6 mm hex key, and each column base has four M10 floor anchors. The largest dismantled part must fit within 1800 × 600 × 100 mm. Print "WAYKEEP" and "Store your gear. Continue your journey." on every station header. Identify compartment states as "Available", "Occupied" and "Service", each paired with a distinct symbol.

Audience: station users, operations staff and our furniture supplier, supporting the range decision, daily operating plan and fabrication brief.

Inputs (attached): 01-client-facts.en.md contains the system dimensions, materials and fixed wording. 02-delivery-catalog.en.md lists each deliverable's proportion, format and stage. 03-equipment-and-sites.en.md contains equipment envelopes, station schedules, door components and operating sequences. equipment-and-station-constraints.png maps the equipment envelopes and three station footprints. existing-d1-doors.png records the existing door proportions, paddle and hinges to retain. daytime-station-reference.png provides the setting and handling context for public use. nighttime-maintenance-reference.png provides the setting and working context for maintenance.

Deliverables:
1. A two-page specification and state schedule covering column dimensions, compartment capacities, materials, connections, dismantled parts and public and maintenance states
2. One system drawing with front, side and plan views of the S4 and L2 columns, shared controls and dimensioned door swings
3. One exploded assembly drawing with a numbered parts schedule, column joints, floor anchors and the largest dismantled part
4. Two compartment studies, one for S4 and one for L2, each showing a section, clear opening, D1 door components and its assigned item moving through the opening
5. Three station layouts, one each for Compact, Standard and Expanded, each combining a dimensioned plan and an assembled perspective with the station header
6. Two public operation storyboards, one for storage and one for retrieval, with numbered steps, control position and compartment state changes
7. One maintenance storyboard showing rear access, compartment isolation, panel removal, lock and wiring access, and return to service
8. One materials and status board with the two specified steels, coating code, removable tray detail and all three word-and-symbol state indicators
9. One 12-second operation video following a helmet from an available compartment through storage to retrieval
10. One presentation document of at least 10 pages reusing the specification, system drawings, compartment studies, three layouts, operation sequences and materials board

Acceptance:
- The specification, system drawing, three station layouts and presentation repeat the 500 mm column pitch and 600 mm cabinet depth; the layouts contain S4/L2 column counts of 1/1, 2/2 and 3/3, giving small/large compartment totals of 4/2, 8/4 and 12/6.
- The two compartment studies dimension minimum clear interiors of 420 × 500 × 360 mm and 420 × 500 × 760 mm and trace the respective 330 × 260 × 250 mm helmet and 320 × 220 × 650 mm backpack through the clear openings. The system drawing and studies retain the D1 door sizes, black recessed paddle and two exposed hinges recorded in the inputs.
- The three station layouts fit their stated footprints, dimension the 1200 mm front and 900 mm rear aisles, and mark door and panel opening envelopes. The public storyboards use the front controls at 1100 mm above the floor; the maintenance storyboard traces the rear approach and the five maintenance stages in 03-equipment-and-sites.en.md.
- The specification, exploded assembly drawing and presentation identify four M8 bolts per column joint, the 6 mm hex key, four M10 anchors per column and a largest dismantled part within 1800 × 600 × 100 mm. The specification, materials board and presentation repeat 1.5 mm galvanized steel, powder coating #243C46 and 2 mm 304 stainless steel trays.
- All three station headers and the presentation opening page carry "WAYKEEP" and "Store your gear. Continue your journey." The materials board pairs "Available", "Occupied" and "Service" with three distinct symbols; the layouts and operation storyboards reuse those pairings wherever a state appears.
- The storage and retrieval storyboards follow the card-operated sequences in 03-equipment-and-sites.en.md. The 12-second video reuses their helmet, compartment geometry and Available–Occupied–Available progression; the presentation reuses all three station layouts and both public sequences across at least 10 pages.

Please clearly mark which version you consider the final deliverable. If nothing is marked, the last exported version counts.
